raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."trans" 
     WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 1997 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date") = 5 
     AND "k_symbol" = 'PENALTY')::DOUBLE /
    NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."trans" 
     WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 1997 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "date") = 4 
     AND "k_symbol" = 'PENALTY')::DOUBLE, 0) AS penalty_transaction_ratio
```
